question: Should OpenClaw adopt `append` as a capability-gated built-in write-tool parameter and optional public `SandboxFsBridge` capability?
rationale: The implementation is additive and well-proven, but it permanently expands both the model-facing tool contract and the Plugin SDK surface; repository policy requires owner intent rather than an automated merge decision.

options.title: Approve both contracts
options.body: Accept the optional tool parameter and bridge capability, then rebase and land after agent-tool, Plugin SDK, and sandbox-owner review.

options.title: Keep append internal
options.body: Preserve native append only for core-owned safety paths while removing the public tool parameter and Plugin SDK baseline expansion.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Do not add a built-in append contract and continue addressing overwrite risk through existing workflow and memory-specific protections.

recommendation.title: Approve both contracts
recommendation.body: Accept the optional tool parameter and bridge capability, then rebase and land after agent-tool, Plugin SDK, and sandbox-owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this contributor to agent-tool availability and runtime-contract decisions, with sandbox security ownership handled separately by CODEOWNERS.
